customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to install, with one noting it fits perfectly on wooden door frames, and appreciate its reliable performance with triple deadlocks for high security. The lock offers multiple unlocking options and has a modern appearance that adds to its appeal, while customers find it easy to use and well-built. The user experience receives mixed feedback, with some customers describing it as a great experience while others find the app terrible.

reviews.author: M N Raghava
reviews.title: No duplicate key maintenance
reviews.body: Very satisfied with this smart lock :-)

reviews.author: Az user
reviews.title: Robust and reliable
reviews.body: Got the Urban Company Native Lock Pro installed recently and so far, I’m really happy with it. The lock is quite responsive and feels solid and robust. The technician visited the very next day after the lock was delivered and completed the installation in less than an hour. The app is also simple and easy to use, which makes the overall experience quite smooth. Hopefully, it continues to perform this well in the long run. 9/10 for me so far.

reviews.author: Nidhi gupta
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: Very good product 👍 Value for money.

reviews.author: Sree
reviews.title: Installation Service - not prompt. Product returned.
reviews.body: Installation support is poor ( was scheduled twice and no show for both occasions ) and finally had to return the item. Item build quality is okay. It runs on AA batteries. Customer support is responsive, but unable to handle their installation partners effectively.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Professional technician
reviews.body: Great experience with the Urban Company Native lock installation. The technician was extremely professional, skilled, and handled the door fitting with neat precision. He also took the time to explain how the smart lock functions, set up the app, and cleared all the drilling mess after finishing the job. 5/5 stars!
